info.title: Innvyra PMS API
info.description: Staff authentication and RBAC. No public registration. IDs are decimal strings. Login/refresh/logout require X-CSRF-Protection: 1. Browser clients must use credentials: include. Refresh sessions have an absolute lifetime (default 7 days); rotation does not extend it. Serialize refresh requests: reuse revokes the entire session. For Swagger Try it out, add this API origin to CORS_ORIGINS.

CreateRoomType.description: Code is trimmed and uppercased. At least one adult; children may be zero. Price is a decimal string, never a JSON number. Unknown fields (including hotelId) are rejected.

CreateRoom.description: Room type must be active and belong to the authenticated hotel. Basement floors may be negative. New rooms must be DIRTY; READY requires a completed cleaning task and authorized inspection. MAINTENANCE requires a Maintenance Block. Unknown fields are rejected.

UpdateRoom.description: Partial update. Reassignment and reactivation require an active room type in the same hotel. housekeepingStatus may only be DIRTY for vacant rooms without active tasks. Other cleaning states require the Housekeeping workflow. MAINTENANCE requires the Maintenance Block workflow. Live tasks/blocks protect operational changes. Reopening an independently restricted room sets DIRTY.

get.description: Roles: ADMIN, MANAGER, RECEPTIONIST. Read-only consistent snapshot. Half-open [checkInDate, checkOutDate); minimum remaining capacity across every night. Active room types and ACTIVE physical rooms only; housekeeping readiness is not a future capacity constraint. Dates must start today or later in hotel.timezone; max nights configured by RESERVATION_MAX_NIGHTS (default 30). Creation rechecks inventory and prices. Zero-availability types are returned with availableRooms=0. No maintenance scheduling.

post.description: Roles: ADMIN, MANAGER, RECEPTIONIST. One transaction locks hotel capacity, validates scoped active guest/types, checks each night, snapshots Decimal prices and confirms all rooms. No temporary hold. Max rooms 20 and nights 30 by default (server configuration). Capacity or partial-write failures roll back the entire reservation. Hotel and actor IDs come from server context; supplied guest/type IDs are checked within that hotel. No physical assignment, tax, discounts or payments. A retried POST is a new booking; creation has no idempotency key.
